tools.name: wincher_get_account
tools.description: The Wincher account behind the token: id, timezone and the plan limits with current usage (websites, users, keywords, keyword lookups, map-tracking credits, history days). Check keyword usage here before adding keywords. GET /account.

tools.name: wincher_get_user
tools.description: The Wincher user the token belongs to: id, role, state, project access and profile (name, email, language). GET /user.

tools.name: wincher_list_search_engines
tools.description: The search engines Wincher can track (id, domain such as google.com, country, languages, default location). GET /search-engines.

tools.name: wincher_search_locations
tools.description: Search the locations Wincher can track rankings for (code, name, country), most popular first, at most 100. Both are required by the API: an ISO country code and a free-text search (at least 3 characters). GET /locations.

tools.name: wincher_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (folders that group websites): id, name, website_ids, user_ids, and optionally the ranking summary for a period. GET /projects.

tools.name: wincher_list_websites
tools.description: List the websites tracked in Wincher: id, domain, display name, search engine, location, language, mobile flag, keyword/group/competitor counts, competitors and brand keywords. Optionally with the ranking summary for a period. GET /websites.

tools.name: wincher_get_website
tools.description: One tracked website with its settings, competitors, brand keywords, counts and (for the period) ranking summary. GET /websites/{website_id}.

tools.name: wincher_list_keywords
tools.description: List the keywords tracked for a website with groups, volume, CPC, difficulty, competition, search intents and, with include_ranking, the latest position, traffic, ranking pages, SERP features and best position in the period. Positions are tracked down to the top 30. GET /websites/{website_id}/keywor

tools.name: wincher_get_keyword
tools.description: One tracked keyword with its groups, volume, CPC, difficulty and (default) ranking for the period. GET /websites/{website_id}/keywords/{keyword_id}.

tools.name: wincher_get_keyword_serps
tools.description: The most recent search result pages Wincher stored for a keyword (up to 30): date, search volume, SERP features and the ranking results (position, URL, domain, traffic). GET /websites/{website_id}/keywords/{keyword_id}/serps.

tools.name: wincher_get_keyword_ranking_history
tools.description: Historical position (or estimated traffic) for ONE keyword as time series, optionally split per ranking page or per competitor. GET /websites/{website_id}/keyword/{keyword_id}/ranking-history.

tools.name: wincher_get_ranking_history_bulk
tools.description: Historical positions for up to 50 keywords at once (one time series per keyword). This is a read: it uses POST only because the keyword id list goes in the body. POST /websites/{website_id}/ranking-history.

tools.name: wincher_list_groups
tools.description: List the keyword groups of a website: id, name, keyword_ids, average difficulty, search-intent counts and optionally ranking summaries. GET /websites/{website_id}/groups.

tools.name: wincher_get_group
tools.description: One keyword group with its keyword ids and (optionally) ranking summary for the period. GET /websites/{website_id}/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: wincher_list_competitors
tools.description: The competitor domains tracked for a website (id, domain, created_at). GET /websites/{website_id}/competitors.

tools.name: wincher_list_competitor_ranking_summaries
tools.description: Ranking summaries (average position, share of voice, traffic, position distribution, volume) for the website's competitors over a period, for comparison with your own. GET /websites/{website_id}/competitors/ranking-summaries.

tools.name: wincher_list_competitor_keyword_positions
tools.description: For each tracked keyword, the position of your site and of each competitor in the period. GET /websites/{website_id}/competitors/keyword-positions.

tools.name: wincher_list_annotations
tools.description: The annotations (notes on the ranking graphs: automatic, alert and user-written) for a website, optionally within a period. GET /websites/{website_id}/annotations.

tools.name: wincher_list_segments
tools.description: The saved segments (keyword filters) usable as segment_id in other tools. By default also temporary ones; only_named limits to saved ones. GET /segments.

tools.name: wincher_add_keywords
tools.description: WRITE: start tracking up to 50 new keywords on ONE website. EACH keyword uses one keyword slot of the plan's keyword quota (see wincher_get_account), and it is tracked and updated from then on; this tool cannot remove keywords again. Each keyword may name a preferred_url (the landing page expected t

tools.name: wincher_create_group
tools.description: WRITE: create a keyword group on a website, optionally containing existing keywords (ids from wincher_list_keywords). Uses no keyword quota. POST /websites/{website_id}/groups.

tools.name: wincher_create_annotation
tools.description: WRITE: add a user annotation (a note shown on the ranking graphs, e.g. 'Launched new landing page') for a date, optionally tied to specific keywords; without keyword_ids it is a global note for the website. Visible to everyone with access to the website. Uses no keyword quota. POST /websites/{websit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wincher_get_user, wincher_get_keyword_serps, wincher_get_ranking_history_bulk · Private data: wincher_get_account, wincher_get_user · Public sink: wincher_get_user, wincher_get_ranking_history_bulk, wincher_list_competitor_ranking_summaries, wincher_add_keywords, wincher_create_group, wincher_create_annotation · Destructive: wincher_add_keywords.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wincher_get_user, wincher_get_keyword_serps, wincher_get_ranking_history_bulk · Private data: wincher_get_account, wincher_get_user · Public sink: wincher_get_user, wincher_get_ranking_history_bulk, wincher_list_competitor_ranking_summaries, wincher_add_keywords, wincher_create_group, wincher_create_annotation · Destructive: wincher_add_keywords

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
